summary: ST-08 is correctly expanded into three leaves matching the named split: WI-08a fresh-save E2E pass plus section 70 checklist, WI-08c section 69 README plus section 68 handoff message, WI-08b spoiler audit as final gate. Dependency order is acyclic and justified (WI-08a -> WI-08c -> WI-08b; all inherit ST-07 via the story). All four parent criteria are carried into the children verbatim, each child has strictly fewer parent criteria (3/2/1 of 4), and the union fully covers the parent with a single named final proof owner per criterion: AC-fin-run and AC-fin-checklist to WI-08a, AC-fin-spoiler to WI-08b (WI-08c explicitly defers ownership), and AC-fin-mvp split into two named halves (layer-evidence to WI-08a, no-development-spoilers to WI-08b). Each leaf is one independently verifiable behavior within the subsystem limit (3/1/1 named subsystems), with focused evidence (recorded headless and browser runs with commands/exit statuses/scenario names, fresh-profile playthrough log, per-criterion layer table, per-artifact audit log, section 69 README diff). Boundaries hold: verification and recording only, product defects routed to the fix-planning route, spoiler rules carried into every leaf, and ST-06's AC-art-map/AC-art-a11y re-verification text is embedded verbatim in WI-08a. Fresh-session handoffs name the exact story plan, request sections, sibling artifacts, and harnesses (src/sim/scenario.ts, shared browser harness) so a fresh implementer can proceed without reconstructing the project.
